name: Tamaki
source: The hair of the Tekiya clan. Unlike his livley companions, it is almost impossible to tell what he might be thinking. His calm and rational nature make him stand out against the rest of the rowdy residents of the Bakuto estate. Despite being the heir of a rival clan, Tamaki has no ill will for the Bakuto clan and even deeply respects them.
